howItWorks.title: Solving fragmentations through digital connection
howItWorks.description: Many customers struggle to find reliable opportunities in one place, while many businesses face limited visibility. Amamazanonaha Ltd solves this by creating a central digital platform for discoverability and commercial opportunity.

step1.title: Businesses & Brands Join
step1.desc: Local businesses and brands create listings for the products and services they offer. Verified profiles help customers understand what you sell, where you operate, and what makes your offer trustworthy.

step2.title: Digital Marketing & Promotion
step2.desc: We promote your listings through targeted campaigns and community-focused outreach. This ensures the right customers discover your offer when they’re searching for solutions.

step3.title: Customers Discover & Order
step3.desc: Customers browse, compare, and order with confidence. From local needs to unique experiences, everything is available in one place—reducing friction and improving trust.

step4.title: Creators & Partners Earn
step4.desc: Creators, delivery partners, and affiliates earn through partnerships. We help match opportunities with people who can deliver value—while keeping the process simple and rewarding.

step5.title: Technology → Local Impact
step5.desc: Our technology connects communities to commerce. The result is measurable local impact—more opportunities, stronger businesses, and a growing economy driven by everyday people.

guide.title: Integrate Your Live TikTok Account
guide.desc: To display your live TikTok posts dynamically without slowing down your site, we use Curator.io - a safe and free responsive social media feed builder.
guide.step1Desc: Go to curator.io and register for a free account.
guide.step2Desc: Select TikTok source, authenticate or search for @amamazanonaha.ltd, and create a feed.
guide.step3Title: Add your Widget ID to Environment Variables
guide.step3Desc: Copy the unique hash identifier of your published feed (looks like a long string of letters and numbers).
guide.tip: Tip: after adding the ID to your .env file, restart the development server to see the live feed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: What people ask us most about the platform, and what it does for customers and businesses.

problem.q: What problem does Amamazanonaha Ltd solve?
problem.a: We solve the absence of a single trusted platform bringing together business information, products and services. We help customers find what they need easily and quickly, and we help companies become better known and reach new business opportunities.

technology.q: How does Amamazanonaha Ltd use technology to solve it?
technology.a: We have built a modern digital platform that connects people, companies and markets. Customers can search, compare and choose trusted products and services without leaving where they are.

customers.a: Customers get reliable information in one place and more options to choose from, and they can compare and decide with confidence — saving both time and money.

businesses.q: What do businesses and brands gain?
businesses.a: Businesses become more visible in the market, build trust, reach more customers, and find new opportunities to sell and to work with partners.
